source: Claude, d'après l'arbre du dépôt et le README
explication_en: Main.hs calls Update.hs, which consults Repology to detect new versions, ignores packages in Skiplist and rewrites the Nix expressions with Rewrite.hs. It verifies the result, runs nixpkgs-review, then pushes with Git.hs and opens the pull request via GH.hs, enriching the description with CVEs from NVD.
